title: How far can light twist a shape? An introduction to Affine length bounds the conformal excursion on a null cone: a sharp focusing inequality
description: An introduction, without equations, to a research paper on how far the shape of a light cone can be distorted by a gravitational wave, as measured by a sharp bound on the conformal excursion of a null cone in terms of affine length. The paper has the proofs; this note has the idea, and it says which claims are proved and which are only computed.
